items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: me and Paul was talking about, he asked me how we met him.

ctx.x: Sure. But I just don't, you know what I mean. I don't, you know. A lot of people, you see I tell it to a lot of people, a lot of people think, if you say you're drinking, they think you think you're sick more than anybody. No, no, you don't think you're sick more than anybody. You know what I mean? What be useful in something where you don't agree with you and make you sick? You know what I mean? That's why I used to, look, that's why I quit drinking coffee. Used to give me a lot of gas. And I just quit drinking.…
Tell me something, how come you sing so high when you sing milk cow blues?
